description: This file defines the PEAR_Command_Registry class, which implements commands for listing, inspecting, and testing PEAR packages within the PEAR command-line interface. It includes methods for listing installed packages, listing files in packages, testing package installation, and displaying detailed package information.

classes.name: PEAR_Command_Registry
classes.description: Class providing PEAR command-line commands for package listing, file listing, package testing, and package info display.

methods.name: doList
methods.description: Lists installed PEAR packages in the default channel or all channels, or lists files in a package.

methods.name: doListAll
methods.description: Lists all installed PEAR packages across all channels.

methods.name: doFileList
methods.description: Lists files within a specified installed package or package file.

methods.name: doShellTest
methods.description: Tests if a package is installed and optionally if it meets version requirements.

methods.name: doInfo
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specified package or package file.

methods.name: _doInfo2
methods.description: Helper method to display detailed info from a package object.
